title: bug(eonio): follow upstream convention
body:
Was chatting with graeme and some folks from his group and they were bitten by the wrong ordering wrt upstream EON. This is a breaking change from the reproduciblity perspective (existing `.con` files read with older ASE versions will have different cell vectors), dunno if it needs more discussion here though.

comments.author: ajjackson
comments.body:
This sounds like more of a bugfix than breaking change, so that might not be too concerning.

I don't quite understand the issue timeline, though. Which code changed convention, and when? Could there be some kind of version dependent behaviour switch?

comments.author: askhl
comments.body: I agree that since there was a comment in the code stating that the ordering was intentional, it would be nice to know when and why something changed, or whether it was wrong all along (which would be surprising).

comments.author: HaoZeke
comments.body: Looking at the `git blame` it seems I ended up causing this during a refactor and then compounded it by leaving a comment and a test case, so this is a bug (the 2012 version was fine) and should go in ASAP.

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
I suppose this wasn't the most widely used feature or we'd have known.  I'll just merge.

Thanks a lot for the fix @HaoZeke!
